name: 84526 · Helper, UT
findings: ZIP 84526 (Helper) has 16 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 84526 (Helper) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
